name: Ness Electronics, Inc.
old_description: The ALL NEW Televes Multi-Market 8 Bay is here. It's a great antenna if you need a Bi-directional antenna. We partnered with Televes to design this antenna and it is exclusively available at Ness Electronics.
about:
Ness Electronics, Inc. is based in Burnsville, Minnesota, and operates from a facility in Mendota Heights after becoming part of Industry Tech Sales. In a recent transition, the company relocated to 1420 Perron Road East, Suite 200, in Mendota Heights, Minnesota, and now functions under the Industry Tech Sales umbrella.

The company operates an online store and wholesale program supplying antennas and related accessories. It carries brands such as Sky Blue Antennas, BullFrog, Winegard, and Screen Kleen, and holds an exclusive partnership with Televes for the co-designed Multi-Market 8 Bay antenna. Ness Electronics does not manufacture its own products but serves as a distributor and authorized dealer for these lines. The company’s online storefront offers direct-to-consumer sales while its wholesale division provides volume pricing to trade customers.

Its customers include professional installers, retail stores, audio/video dealers, and eye-care professionals who recommend its screen-cleaning products. The wholesale program targets installers and stores seeking volume pricing. The product lineup emphasizes long-range reception and durability, with the Sky Blue series marketed for fringe-area reception up to 65 miles.

Ness Electronics differentiates itself through exclusive product arrangements, a five-year warranty on Sky Blue antennas, and a focus on serving professional installers with dedicated wholesale pricing. The exclusive Televes partnership and the five-year warranty on Sky Blue antennas are highlighted as key differentiators in the company’s messaging.
